notes: ICD-10-CM C50.9 = malignant neoplasm of breast, unspecified site; a real public code set, applied at topography level only.
ICD-10-CM C18.9 = malignant neoplasm of colon, unspecified; colorectal spans C18-C20, C18.9 used as representative topography code.
ICD-10-CM C34.90 = malignant neoplasm of unspecified part of unspecified bronchus or lung; histology (NSCLC vs SCLC) is not separately coded in ICD-10-CM topography.
ICD-10-CM C61 = malignant neoplasm of prostate.
ICD-10-CM C43.9 = malignant melanoma of skin, unspecified.
ICD-10-CM C25.9 = malignant neoplasm of pancreas, unspecified.
ICD-10-CM C56.9 = malignant neoplasm of unspecified ovary.
No single ICD-10-CM code covers the 'head and neck cancer' umbrella (it spans oral cavity/pharynx/larynx categories C00-C14 and C32); left unmapped rather than picking an arbitrary subsite code.
